determinism_scope: Frozen evidence rounds, seeded admission order; commuting PostgreSQL events may interleave

fault_schedule: round0: ambiguous timeout; request may have committed, be absent, or remain in flight
round1: opaque receipt lookup; no outcome eliminated
round2: authoritative quiescence certificate; no request remains in flight
round3: authoritative committed or terminal-abort receipt
scenarios.causal_contract: IN_FLIGHT can later COMMIT or become definitively ABSENT; no bound assumed
